en.t: This refers to Wu Ding, king of Yin.

units.source_text: 武丁三年不言，政治决于冢宰。

en.t: Wu Ding did not speak for three years, and affairs of government were decided by the chief minister.

units.source_text: 后以梦求得傅说，以为相，国大治。

en.t: Later, through a dream, he found Fu Yue, made him his minister, and the country became well governed.
